body:
Can't we just reduce the `editor_minimum_size`? If not for all platform then only on Andoid (ifdef ANDROID_ENABLED)

btw, why do we even need such hardcoded values? Shouldn't Control nodes maintain it's minimum size?

`window_get_size() is the main window size, it has nothing to do with display size. While by default editor is maximized, it can also be opened with saved project specific smaller window size, if it was closed in non maximized mode.

So should be `screen_get_usable_rect(iDisplayServerEnums::SCREEN_OF_MAIN_WINDOW)` instead.

Theoretically, we shouldn't need these hardcoded values, and I am not sure why they are in place. Will investigate. 
The reason I can think of on the spot is that with a dynamic UI like Godot has, the computed minimum size may vary based on what is being displayed or not (which is a fact we are abusing with this change), and making that size expand dynamically might not behave well with the window?
